fidelity: F2a — Magnetizing-Branch Equivalent Circuit with Nonlinear-Flux ODE (CT saturation)
source: IEEE Std C57.13-2016 (Instrument Transformers); IEC 61869-1/-2/-3 (2007-2011); Slemon & Straughen (1980) Electric Machines; IEEE PSRC, CT SAT Calculator / IEEE C37.110 Guide for CTs in Protective Relaying; Hoblit (1980) Current Transformers, IEEE Trans. Ind. Appl.

unit.name: Generic Current Transformer (CT), 200/5A, Class 0.5, 15 VA, 50 Hz

type.note: CT (current transformer) or PT (inductive voltage transformer)

turns_ratio.note: n = N1/N2 = 200/5 = 40 for CT; N_primary/N_secondary for PT

N2.note: Secondary turns (200/5 CT -> 40 primary turns of 1, 100 sec turns approx; sets flux per amp)

V_rated.note: Primary rated voltage (PT) — not used for CT

S_burden_VA.note: Rated VA burden at rated secondary current

pf_burden.note: Burden power factor (standard 0.8 lag per IEEE C57.13 B-0.5)

Xm.note: Unsaturated magnetizing reactance, referred to secondary

V_knee.note: Knee-point EMF (IEC: secondary EMF where 10% V rise -> 50% I rise). Above this the core saturates

B_sat.note: Saturation flux density of grain-oriented silicon steel (CRGO ~1.7-2.0 T)

accuracy_class.note: IEC/IEEE accuracy class (0.5 = ±0.5% ratio error at rated burden)

phase_class_min.note: Permitted phase displacement at class 0.5 (IEC 61869: 30 min = 0.5 deg)

i_primary_A.note: For CT; up to 20x rated for fault/saturation studies

burden_fraction.note: Burden as multiple of rated VA
